title: IEEE binary64 special-value preservation
contract: An identity transformation must preserve NaN classification and the sign of zero under the stated observation profile.
scope: Named binary64 values +0,-0,+1,-1,+inf,-inf,nan; strict profile admitted; compare NaN class, not payload.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: NaN classification and infinity signs are preserved.
Non-NaN observations preserve exact value and sign including negative zero.
